# FLX-3116: a generator plugin comes from another distribution or version than the bundle pins

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A bundle pins the distribution and the exact version that must provide a plugin. The distribution is compared by its normalized name (lower case, with every run of hyphens, underscores and dots as one hyphen), and the version as written. The message names the distribution and version the entry point comes from and the ones the bundle declares. Install the pinned version, or change the pin in the bundle and review the change. Nothing was imported.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3116
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
